headline: Backend/DevOps engineer who ships regulated fintech systems
summary: I am a Bangkok-based engineer with 4+ years of experience building backend systems in Python/Django and running them on Google Cloud. For the last two years I have worked on a Bank of Thailand-regulated P2P lending platform, where correctness, auditability and uptime are not optional. I like turning messy manual processes into reliable, automated ones.
strengths: Designing secure, auditable Django APIs and back-office tools for regulated products
Running production infrastructure on GCP (App Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager) with Docker
Performance profiling and fixing slow endpoints, plus automated CSV/PDF/Word reporting
Business continuity and security work: BCP testing, penetration-test remediation and vendor selection
